name: fs-local
description: The fs@1 provider `local-fs`: the LOCAL filesystem of the workbench host behind the capability contract - reads unrestricted, WRITES confined to the configured roots. Declares execution/policies because it touches host paths directly (no shell, no transport).

config.description: The allowed roots, the default cwd, the symlink policy and the per-call byte/result caps.

roots.description: Absolute (or cwd-relative) directories WRITES are confined to. Default: [cwd]. A write outside them fails with reason fs.outside-root.

cwd.description: Directory a relative path resolves against for BOTH reads and writes (default: the process cwd).

followSymlinks.description: Follow a symlink to its target in stat/read (false = observe the link itself). Confinement is still enforced on the RESOLVED path.

maxReadBytes.description: Byte cap of one read call.

maxWriteBytes.description: Byte cap of one write/append/edit payload.

ignore.description: Directory names the glob/grep walk never descends into (default: [".git", "node_modules"]).

grep.description: The content-search engine: `node` (default, pure RegExp) or `ripgrep` (needs `binary`: absolute rg path).

binary.description: Absolute rg binary path (required by the ripgrep engine).

maxResults.description: Inline match cap; the rest goes to the spill file.

maxFileBytes.description: Files larger than this are skipped.

maxTotal.description: Hard ceiling on collected matches before the walk stops.

sandbox.description: EXTENSION POINT: an explicit sandbox policy ({ writeRoots, readRoots, readOnly, source }) intersected with (never added to) the config above, so it can only make the seam stricter. See definitions/fs.ts, 'Sandbox extension point'.
